    Quotients of algebras with twisted multiplicative bases #

    Let B be a twisted multiplicative basis of A over a finite ray category P, and μ a non-invertible morphism. The span of the basis elements of the morphisms factoring through μ is a two-sided ideal (RayQuiver.MulBasis.ideal), and A modulo it has a twisted multiplicative basis over the residue category P/μ (RayQuiver.MulBasis.quot). Consequently, if that quotient is representation-finite, P/μ has bounded chains (RayQuiver.MulBasis.chainBounded_res).
